title: Metastore v1alpha: Lakehouse Proxy Config & Read-Only Fields
summary: The Metastore v1alpha API introduces Lakehouse proxy configuration for phased namespace migrations. The new 'lakehouseProxyConfig' field in the Service schema and its sub-properties are now explicitly read-only, which is a breaking change.
details: A new `LakehouseProxyConfig` schema has been added to the Metastore v1alpha API, enabling configuration for Dataproc Metastore to Lakehouse proxy routing during phased namespace migrations. This configuration is exposed via the new `lakehouseProxyConfig` property within the `Service` schema. This update includes a breaking change: the `lakehouseProxyConfig` property itself, along with its nested `catalog` and `namespaces` properties, are now explicitly marked as read-only (output-only). Developers who were previously attempting to set these properties in any capacity will need to update their clients to reflect their immutable nature.
